$comment: Shared by tests/unit/files.test.ts and worker/tests/test_storage_backend.py. Storage keys are built in BOTH TypeScript (src/files/storage.ts) and Python (worker/storage.py), because the worker writes the derivatives the web service serves and the compiled documents it hands to a reader. The two must agree exactly: a key shape that drifts orphans every existing file behind a 404, and the row in the database would still look correct. This file is the single source for the fixtures so neither implementation can change alone while both suites stay green.
$rejected: Keys both implementations must refuse. A traversal cannot escape an S3 bucket, but it would still address an object nothing else can name, so the rule holds on both backends in both languages.
$rejectedDerivatives: Arguments derivative_key must refuse, as [sha256, variant, extension].
